visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a sunny suburban setting with a young woman standing before a white picket fence and a light-colored wooden house. She wears a white Levi's cropped t-shirt and blue denim shorts, smiling and posing with her hands on her hips. (2) The scene shifts to her standing in front of a wooden fence and a red 'STOP' sign. She has added a dark denim jacket and striking confident, energetic poses. Lighting is bright with high-contrast shadows. (3) Transitions to a Taiwanese street scene. She is seen riding a white bicycle through a sun-dappled urban alleyway with green trees. She wears a grey knit vest and wide-leg baggy jeans, her hair styled with a patterned bandana. (4) The final segment shows her at a train station. She is dressed in a plaid shirt layered over a grey top with beige cargo pants. She stands on the platform as a train passes, then sits inside a vintage-style train car, looking contemplatively out the window as sunlight streams in.
